attestation: Leave pending fields untouched until a genuine person reviews. Only the actual reviewer may provide identity, completion and independent-human attestation.
do_not_force: Use false or uncertainty when unsupported, unsafe, ambiguous or unhelpful; do not revise the frozen question or source.
first_pass: Read source and actual claim; independently answer the frozen question, identify exact Unicode character spans, assess origin and all five QA criteria.
scope: QA/provenance review of one contribution; it cannot complete human safety validation of the remaining cohort.
second_pass: Only after sealing first-pass answers, a coordinator may supply the candidate reference for independent checking. Preserve both passes.
